name: WLF_MESSAGES
description: This table will be used to store all error and warning messages that are thrown during validation of the state of the learning item.

columns.name: MESSAGE_CODE
columns.description: The fusion message name/key which can be used to lookup the appropriate translated value of the message

columns.name: MESSAGE_CATEGORY
columns.description: Category of the message such as whether it is related to validation, transcoding, integration, etc.

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: The unique id of the source object to which this message applies

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: The type of the source object that this message is applicable to

columns.name: VALIDATION_STATUS
columns.description: The status of the validation - ORA_ACTIVE / ORA_RESOLVED / ORA_IGNORE

columns.name: SEVERITY
columns.description: The severity of the message - 1 for Error, 2 for Warning, 3 for Info

columns.name: VISIBILITY
columns.description: The visibility of the message - ORA_SHOW / ORA_HIDE

columns.name: TRACE_ID
columns.description: An internal identifier that can be used by Support/Dev team to trace the source/cause of the error

columns.name: LOG
columns.description: Text to provide more information about the error

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
